AccelShell™ is Clark Pacific's prefabricated insulated wall panel and enclosure solution for data centers and other critical facilities. The system combines a durable precast concrete exterior, continuous insulation, interior concrete wythe, engineered connections, and coordinated joint detailing into a factory-produced wall assembly.
Why choose AccelShell™ instead of a conventional field-built wall system?
Can AccelShell™ be used as cladding or as a load-bearing wall system?
How does AccelShell™ support durability, fire performance, and sustainability?
Our team works with owners and architects early in the design phase to ensure the right thermal performance and finish for your project.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
